capabilities: embed issue and pull request previews for GitHub links
embed file snippets scoped to line ranges via #L anchors
authenticate GitHub API calls with a personal access token
support private repositories via token permissions
extras: Embeds currently work only in reading mode; the README's Todo lists editor-mode support and per-link opt-in/out as unfinished. The entire file is still requested even when limiting snippet lines, which may be slow for large files.
problem: GitHub links in notes show only plain text unless opened in a browser, so issue details and file contents are not visible in context.

relations.evidence: In order to make use of GitHub's API, calls need to be authenticated.

summary: Plugin that embeds previews of GitHub issues, pull requests, and code file snippets beneath GitHub links in reading mode.
